div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 已存在 (重复提交/网络重试)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 不存在

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 报价过期或价格已变动

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 核价通过

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 否 (真实库存不足)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 是 (库存充足)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: rowcount == 0 (并非缺货, 而是并发版本冲突!)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 是

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 否 (重试3次仍冲突)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 所有 SKU 均扣减成功

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 否 (券已被其他订单占用)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 是

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
POST /api/v1/orders/create
(携带 JWT, idempotency_key, quote_id)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
查询 orders 表:
idempotency_key 是否已存在?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
直接返回已有订单快照 (200 OK, idempotent_replayed=True)
绝不重复扣减库存

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
查询 price_quotes 表校验 quote_id:
1. 归属当前 jwt_user_id?
2. now <= expires_at (15分钟内)?
3. 重新核算实时商品价与券规则是否一致?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
返回 409 QUOTE_EXPIRED_OR_CHANGED
附上最新重算报价请用户重新确认

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
初始化乐观锁重试计数器 retry_count = 0
开启 MySQL 数据库事务 BEGIN

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
遍历订单内各 sku_id:
SELECT sellable_stock, version FROM products_sku WHERE sku_id = :sku

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
检查当前可售库存:
sellable_stock >= required_qty ?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
ROLLBACK 事务
写入失败记录并返回 422 INSUFFICIENT_STOCK
(此时才允许引导 selection_agent 推荐同品类替代品)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
执行带版本号的乐观锁更新:
UPDATE products_sku
SET sellable_stock = sellable_stock - :qty, version = version + 1
WHERE sku_id = :sku AND version = :ver AND sellable_stock >= :qty

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 检查受影响行数 rowcount == 1 ?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
ROLLBACK 当前尝试
检查 retry_count < 3 ?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
retry_count += 1
指数退避等待 (20ms / 50ms / 100ms)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
返回 503 CONCURRENT_VERSION_CONFLICT
提示系统繁忙请稍后再试 (严禁误报为缺货!)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
锁定用户优惠券:
UPDATE user_coupons SET status='LOCKED', order_id=:oid
WHERE user_coupon_id IN (:cids) AND status='UNUSED'

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 优惠券锁定成功?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
ROLLBACK 事务
返回 409 COUPON_UNAVAILABLE

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
写入 orders 与 order_items 表
(状态 STOCK_LOCKED, 金额全部精确到分 cents)
COMMIT 提交事务

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 返回 201 Created 订单详情与模拟支付入口
